description: This file contains tests for the function 'appendUnreleasedChangelogEntry', which manipulates changelog text by appending entries to the 'Unreleased' section. It defines test cases that verify proper appending behavior, duplication avoidance, and error handling when the 'Unreleased' section is missing.

methods.name: appendUnreleasedChangelogEntry
methods.description: Function that adds a new entry to a specified section in the changelog's 'Unreleased' portion, avoiding duplicates and throwing if the section is missing.
